saw_lines: Premium meat buyers pick one source, trust it for the first bite, then reorder it on a schedule without comparing shelves.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the story has to earn trust before the price shows up.
Your 14 ads carry 0 proof numbers and your site shows none, so collect your review count and orders shipped, then lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 10 Oct 2026
points: 5 of your 14 ads open on the same pasture raised line, so they compete with each other for one set of buyers. Test three new openers against it: a price objection, a Sunday roast moment, and a customer quote.
The offer sits outside your ads

Your site pushes 15% subscription savings, yet 1 of 14 ads mention it and 0 mention free shipping, so buyers have no reason to act. Headline 15% on two retention ads and open a new buyer ad with free shipping.

Neither your site nor your 14 ads shows a proof number, so buyers only have your word on pasture raised and no hormones. Collect your review count and orders shipped this month, then lead with that number on the creative.

All 14 ads started within 10 days, so budget is spread across untested ideas and none has proven it can scale. Make three new variations of the oldest ad, the Taste the Difference video, then scale the one that holds up.

ads_1: Price, Sunday roast and customer quote angles tested against the pasture raised opener
